description:
FOUND by a2775 (s510, 2026-10-06), section A of docs/ctx-bind-fallback-analysis-s510.md.  Each of these runtime functions reads *wantarray* (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: p-getpw*/p-getgr* take `&key (wantarray (eq *wantarray* t))`, p-glob and the p-readline macro test `(eq *wantarray* t)`) but none is in Pl/ExprToCL.pm's %WANTARRAY_SENSITIVE, whose own INVARIANT says it must list every such built-in.  In a LIST slot they pass today only because of the list-only fallback bind (#2775); in a SCALAR slot they are emitted BARE and read whatever the enclosing code bound -- inside the argument list of a list-context call that is t, so they return the list.

PROBES (/home/bernt/pcl/.claude/worktrees/agent-a24e9cbaab6227172/scratch/a2775/probe-a4.pl rows S-pwnam S-pwuid S-grgid S-glob S-readline): PCL ARRAY(0x1)..ARRAY / perl 0, root, root, /etc/passwd, root:.  With the eight names added to the table (the a2775 trial, variant 3) all five rows match perl and the list-slot probe /home/bernt/pcl/.claude/worktrees/agent-a24e9cbaab6227172/scratch/a2775/probe-a5.pl stays identical.

FIX = the table addition, which is also the precondition for removing #2775's fallback (without it, removing the fallback breaks the LIST slot of all eight: probe-a5.pl, 9 rows).  (The set/end*ent four read *wantarray* as a default argument and ignore it -- they need nothing.)  Exposes #489 in one probe row (glob's scalar iterator is keyed by PATTERN): /home/bernt/pcl/.claude/worktrees/agent-a24e9cbaab6227172/scratch/a2775/probe-a4.pl SUBL-S-glob moves from /etc/passwd to /etc/passwd- once S-glob really runs in scalar context.
subject: SILENT WRONG (pre-existing): getpwnam/getpwuid/getpwent/getgrnam/getgrgid/getgrent, glob(...) and readline(...) are missing from %WANTARRAY_SENSITIVE -- in a SCALAR slot under an outer list bind they return the LIST (`f("" . getpwuid 0)` gives "ARRAY(0x1)", perl "root")
